.article-rte img: /media/yhqdqij5/saltstoneintegrator-02.jpg?mode=crop&width=1920&height=1080 | caption=The basic Integrator is a harness system for carrying a long gun. It can even be adapted for carrying two firearms at once. Image courtesy of Saltstone.

/media/oqga233q/saltstoneintegrator-03.jpg?mode=crop&width=1920&height=1080 | caption=The Integrator holds the firearm muzzle up and forward and is deployed with a quick-release catch. The firearm can go from secured into a shooting position in about a second.
/media/et2flcsm/saltstoneintegrator-04.jpg?mode=crop&width=1920&height=1080 | caption=The Integrator is designed to carry scoped firearms in an optics-forward position.
/media/u30brg01/saltstoneintegrator-05.jpg?mode=crop&width=1920&height=1080 | caption=Firearms can quickly transition from secure to on target instantly with the Integrator system.

/media/wdvj1ur0/saltstoneintegrator-06.jpg?mode=crop&width=1920&height=1080 | caption=The Integrator carries a long gun much more securely than a traditional sling, leaving the hands free for other field tasks.

/media/zcepsdei/saltstoneintegrator-07.jpg?mode=crop&width=1920&height=1080 | caption=The accessory 5-liter pack can be mounted to the rear or front (shown) of the Integrator system. When mounted on the front, it can serve as a binocular or handgun case.
/media/gzfnwmzd/saltstoneintegrator-08.jpg?mode=crop&width=1920&height=1080 | caption=Among the accessories that turn the Integrator into an upland rig are a no-spill shell pouch.
/media/kxrdd4he/saltstoneintegrator-09.jpg?mode=crop&width=1920&height=1080 | caption=The 12-liter game pouch adapts the Integrator for a day in the field.
